messages:
leah.pm: Quick announcement: were opening a small private preview for NVIDIA GH200 Dedicated capacity in us-west-3 (oakland). This is targeted at customers doing very large model training-inference hybrids and long-context retrieval workloads.

leah.pm: Key customer ask: more HBM and NVLink scale for multi-card model shards. GH200 gives us higher aggregate HBM per host which should help embeddings + large context generation.

toni.eng: Short tech summary: GH200 hosts are 4x GH200-64GB boards per server with our NUMA-aware allocator and a custom NVLink topology. Early internal tests show 2.3x memory bandwidth for KV-heavy workloads vs A100-80GB.

toni.eng: Notes: scheduling limits default to 1 host per tenant in preview. For multi-host experiments please submit a support ticket with justification.

nate.ops: Rollout plan: preview pool name gh200-us-oak-preview, soft-launch now with 3 reserved tenants and 10 trial seats. GA targeted in ~30 days pending stability and cost validation. Preview is no SLA and will have a temporary billing tag "preview-gh200".

nate.ops: Please do not enroll production traffic on this pool yet. Use the preview tag so telemetry is segregated.

billing-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: preview-gh200 to pool gh200-us-oak-preview by nate.ops at 2026-04-09T15:12:00Z

ana.sales: Sales heads-up: Ill send a short one-pager to AEs about target use-cases (hybrid train/infer, long context RAG). Recommend we note limited capacity and approval workflow.

toni.eng: Ops checklist (short):
```
- Add gh200-us-oak-preview to routing with fallbacks: a100-us-west, l4-us-west.
- Enforce per-tenant host cap = 1 for preview.
- Enable KV shard balancing and aggressively monitor HBM utilization.
- Disable speculative quantization by default on these nodes.
```

toni.eng: Example redwoodctl snippet for trying the pool: 
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-gh200-oak-01 --units 1 --duration 7d --justification "gh200 trial" 
```

leah.pm: Action items: Toni monitor perf/regressions daily; Nate keep quota list and weekly snapshot; Ana prepare AE note; Billing to hold GA pricing. Post customer requests here.

nate.ops: Will publish weekly capacity snapshot in #eng-ops and ping here for major incidents.

leah.pm: If anyone in support sees OOMs or timeouts, include the job-id and sample input and tag @toni.eng.

ana.sales: Thanks team  will reach out to the handful of enterprise customers that asked for high-memory GPUs.

billing-bot: [note] pool-gh200-oak-01 health: YELLOW (2 nodes reporting high memory pressure, one undergoing remediation)

leah.pm: Aware of the health note  Nate, can you post remediation ETA here when available?

nate.ops: On it  root cause appears to be a misconfigured NVLink firmware on one node, remediation underway, ETA 3 hours.

leah.pm: Thanks, closing the announce thread. Ill follow up with a short internal FAQ and access form link in the next 12 hours.
